en.quote: Of course, we do not intend to plunge headlong into this conflict [in Syria].
en.head: Russia established a long-term military presence in Syria.
en.body: After Putin said Russia would not plunge “headfirst” into the conflict, the operation continued and an agreement secured its naval facility in Tartus for 49 years, with possible extensions. Putin ordered a partial withdrawal in December 2017, but the bases remained. This diverged from the picture of limited involvement; the metaphor has no measurable threshold.

osrc.t: RBC, on the law ratifying the Tartus agreement
